prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right one depends on what you need (services, budget, industry, timeline, how hands-on you want them to be). I can help you find the best fit if you tell me a few things — but below are quick guidelines plus a couple of well-known KC agencies to consider.

Quick questions so I can narrow it down
- What marketing services do you need? (brand/creative, digital/paid media, SEO, social, PR, content, account-based marketing, website/product, etc.)
- What’s your annual marketing budget or typical monthly spend?
- Are you a B2B or B2C business, and what industry are you in?
- Do you want a local agency you can meet in person, or are remote/national okay?
- Timeline and goals (awareness, lead generation, e‑commerce sales, rebrand, etc.)?

Well-known Kansas City agencies (examples)
- Barkley — independent, full-service creative and strategy agency known for strong brand and creative work.
- VMLY&R / VML — global integrated/digital-first agency with deep capabilities in brand, digital, and experience design; has major presence in KC.

(Those two are frequently recommended for larger brand and integrated work. There are also many smaller local agencies and specialists for digital performance, SEO, social media and B2B demand generation.)

How to choose — criteria to use
- Relevant experience: case studies in your industry or with similar goals.
- Measurable results: examples with performance metrics (traffic, leads, ROAS).
- Team and chemistry: who will actually do the work, and do they understand your business?
- Services and technical fit: do they cover everything you need or will you need multiple vendors?
- Reporting/process: how frequently and in what format will they report results?
- Budget and pricing model: retainer, project-based, performance-based, media markups.
- References: ask for client references you can contact.

If you want, I can:
- Suggest a short list of Kansas City agencies tailored to your needs and budget (3–7 options).
- Draft an RFP or shortlist interview questions to evaluate agencies.
Tell me the service types, budget range, and industry and I’ll build a recommended shortlist.
